Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
DOC-0054 2026-10-03
RETROSPECTIVE — A Structures Attachment Filed Under
the Meeting Name
Date: 2026-10-08
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Recorder: PERSON-0022, TEAM-0004
What happened A structures review attachment was filed under the meeting's
short name rather than the heading supplied by the collecting desk. The next
clerk searched the source heading and could not locate the paper in the
expected folder. ISSUE-0172 and TASK-0458 identify the discussion folder for
this retrospective.
What helped The appointment diary retained the collecting role and the date
the paper was expected. The filing clerk used that context to trace the local
meeting heading. Preserving the received attachment made it possible to
compare the source title with the index label without recreating the paper
from memory.
What changes Record source heading and filing heading together on the
index. When a location is corrected, keep a dated note of the original folder
route and the receiving location. A quiet refile would solve the immediate
search while leaving the next clerk unable to explain the earlier trail.
The review coordinator will attach the location-correction note to the original
collecting request. The incoming desk should know which heading to search
and which role can explain a mismatch. A meeting title may remain a useful
alias, but it must not displace the source heading.
Follow-up PERSON-0022 will review the dual-heading index with the station
records clerk on 2026-10-05. Retain the ambiguous meeting label on the
teaching copy to show why the correction was needed.
D. Worker 0022
Demo Worker 0022, Demo Team 04
